decision: Preserve this partial run as a failed technical audit. Do not resume it, repair its six invalid rows, or combine any of its output with a later run. Revise the general input-display contract, rerun the stress pilot under one new contract hash, and rerun all 35,213 windows into a new empty output directory.

hive_job.cancellation_reason: A rolling strict-output audit found a reproducible corpus-wide JSON control-character defect. The job was cancelled before more GPU time was spent under an invalid contract.

preserved_partial_output.output_inventory_hash_definition: SHA-256 of the sorted UTF-8 lines '<basename>  <file_sha256>\n' for all 35 preserved chunk_*.out.jsonl.gz files

failure_diagnostic.mechanism: The unchanged source segment was displayed to the model with literal C0 control characters. The model copied source tabs literally inside JSON string values instead of emitting JSON escape sequences. A literal tab is invalid in a JSON string, so the required strict parser rejected the otherwise complete outputs before alignment.
failure_diagnostic.why_local_row_repair_is_prohibited: Accepting invalid JSON with a permissive parser or escaping only the six observed rows would weaken the corpus-wide contract and create nonuniform provenance. The correction must be deterministic, general, contract-bound, and applied before inference to every window.

c1_controls_deliberately_unchanged.decision: Do not transform these characters under the narrow invalid-JSON correction. Any broader source-quality normalization would be a separate documented decision.

required_corrective_gate: Keep the authoritative extraction source text, hashes, and Unicode offsets unchanged.

Preserve line feeds and quotes in the prompt. Use one reversible minimal model-display codec that escapes backslashes and non-LF C0 controls only; do not convert the full page into JSON-string display text or alter C1 controls under this correction.

Before parsing, use one narrow lexical canonicalizer that escapes raw U+0000 through U+001F only when they occur inside a JSON string. Retain the verbatim generation, reject every other malformed condition, and pass the canonical payload through the existing strict duplicate-key, nonfinite-number, and invalid-escape parser.

Bind the display-codec and canonicalizer specification identifiers and hashes, raw and canonical payload hashes, exact repair counts, and generation configuration into the extraction contract and output provenance.
Keep exact decoded-string alignment against the unchanged source. Do not rescue display-encoded strings that fail direct source alignment.

Rerun a complete-parent stress pilot covering 867 parents and 1,787 windows. Its manifest must attest all 962 changed-display windows, all prior controls, their 1,021-window union, and named dense-tab, short-tab, and U+0003 controls.
Rerun the complete stress pilot under the new contract, then rerun all 35,213 windows into a new empty directory. Never resume or merge this cancelled output.
